newsitem.title: POLAND: Forte eyes PLN 26 mln 1997 net.
newsitem.headline: Forte eyes PLN 26 mln 1997 net.

text.p: Polish furniture maker Forte SA plans to boost domestic market share to nine percent by the end of 1998 from the current 6.9 percent and to net 26 million zlotys in 1997, the firm's financial director said on Thursday.
Andrzej Korzeb told Reuters that Forte's 1996 net profit of 20.7 million zlotys fell 5.1 million zlotys short of the company's plan because of a delay in its investment programme.
"The lower result was caused mainly by a delay in our investment programme and an unfavourable German mark rate at the end of the year," Korzeb said.
Korzeb said the firm plans to increase operations on the promising China market.
Currently about 60 percent of the firm's sales come from export and Korzeb said Germany was Forte's largest buyer, accounting for between 30 and 40 percent of its sales.
